event.description: Reduce the learned tied token code/projection factorization from rank 5 to rank 4 while retaining factorized rank-3 positions, shared no-offset normalization, d=14, two blocks, ff=19, and the successful 75000-step schedule.
event.proposal: Family: token representation. Retained incumbent is attempt-0055 with 2915 parameters at 99.970000%, a +0.970000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the most recent accepted result is attempt-0055, rank-5 learned tied token codes (2915, 99.97%); the most recent failed result is attempt-0052, rank 5 under a shorter 45000-step schedule, an optimization failure ending at 98.30% validation; 6 prior token-representation macro attempts. Hypothesis: after the accepted rank-5 code compressed the tied token table, one further latent coordinate may remain redundant when the factorized positional representation and longer schedule are unchanged. This is a representational token-subspace compression, not parameterization-preserving scalar pruning: rank 4 replaces 15x5 plus 5x14 weights with 15x4 plus 4x14 weights and lowers the actual count from 2915 to 2886. It is more informative than rank 3 because it tests the immediate lower-rank boundary without conflating the result with a two-coordinate reduction.
